nodes.name: Normalize Input
nodes.notes: Farm context comes from the request, never from Supabase. Scans carry no disease label. Soil values are carried because soil.status reports them back as recorded facts - they are never interpreted into advice.

nodes.name: Classify Intent
nodes.notes: Deterministic multilingual keyword routing to a closed enum of nine intents. No LLM in v1: a misclassification can only answer the wrong true question, never invent a fact. An LLM classifier could sit ahead of this node emitting the same {intent, cropSlot} shape, with this as its fallback.

nodes.name: Join Answer
nodes.notes: Synchronisation join only. Build Answer reads whichever branch ran by node name, so answer identity never depends on merge ordering. Local intents (diagnosis.recent, soil.status, farm.info, unknown) take no branch at all.

nodes.name: Build Answer
nodes.notes: Emits answerKey + params + sources + signals. Cannot produce a sentence. Params come only from fields a source actually returned; an unavailable source yields an unavailable answer; soil values are reported, never interpreted; schemes report matched counts, never eligibility; the diagnosis answer restates the agent own flag and never sees a disease label.
